The '''battle on the''' '''''[[Devastation]]''''' was a battle between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].

==Prelude==
The Confederacy of Independent Systems and the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] were building the [[Subjugator-class heavy cruiser/Legends|Subjugator-class heavy cruiser]] known as the ''Devastation'', but this was not known by the Jedi before [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] accidentally learned the information from a CIS computer. [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] then sent the Jedi [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] to stop the ship from destroying [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. However before the battle, [[Sai Sircu]] ultimately betrayed the Confederacy and switched the coordinates from [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==The battle==
Ahsoka and Plo Koon were the first to land on the ship, and were instantly attacked by several [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. Once they entered a few doors, they entered a hallway with several [[Cannon/Legends|cannons]] controlled by droids. They then traveled down to a lower location to see that the [[Hyperdrive/Legends|Hyperdrive]] has been activated, meaning the ship must have arrived at its first location. They quickly progress through a heavy door leading to a control room, but at that moment, [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] shows up and challenges the Jedi to a duel, however, knowing that saving Coruscant was more important than killing Ventress, Ahsoka breaks the controls. Knowing her failure, Ventress flees from battle. Soon after, Obi-Wan and Kit Fisto make a landing on the ship. They are encountered by several droids as well, before entering another door. After a few doors, the two Jedi find a reactor in the ship. The two Jedi then overload it, being mindful of staying away from the [[Cam droid/Legends|Camera droids]] in the room. Once the reactor was overloaded, the Camera droids fled for cover along with the Jedi, and a huge hole was formed in the wall from the blast. Soon after Obi-Wan and Kit Fisto made their way to another control room, and engaged [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]. However Obi-Wan cut down the backup controls while the [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] fought off the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] lord. After the two prevailed, [[Sai Sircu]] entered the room and used the force to knock out Obi-Wan and Kit Fisto. Dooku then fled. Finally, Mace Windu and Anakin land and encounter droids like their other fellow Jedi. Soon after, the two Jedi encountered [[Sai Sircu]], and killed her.

==Aftermath==
Once all the Jedi were off the ship, the Republic used a few [[Jedi bomber]]s and bombed the ship. On a nearby ship, [[Ros Lai]], a former Nightsister watches the remains of the ''Devastation'' pass by the ship.
